content: Renegades  Notes  Earth has joined the union of planets  Blake goes off the grid with the Revenant and his crew,  Xera is dead and Seafu has to cope with that  He hunts vengeance to find his daughter before she is taken or worse.  Zanar Praxxis has gone with him.  We start the book with Blake being tortured by the empire as he has left the rangers to find his daughter who was captured at the end of Jamestown by Vengeance. The crew leave the Rangers to find him.  As he is searching for his daughter, the shadows have pulled out all the stops The Consortium of AI’s have decided to end the war, They found the last living Elder, the one who spoke to Blake and using her blood they engineer a “key” that lets them reactivate the ships that have lain dormant since the end of the war,  piloting there ships, they no longer require the empire and now come out to take over the entire galaxy, destroying the armies of the empire and the rangers alike .  At the end of the book we find Blake watching as the army of the rangers last ships are set upon by the AI’s, the Empire comes to  there  rescue and they flee.  We find Blake following the army back, to a remote planet since there base has been destroyed by the AI’s  and we see the Empire , The senate and the Rangers combine forces, to try and beat back the AI’s .
